blocks.text:
## Guatemala and Belize in one trip

In Guatemala, the route takes you through Antigua, Lake Atitlán, Flores, Tikal and Yaxhá. Colonial architecture sits alongside volcanoes and lakes, while archaeological sites reveal cities from the Classic Maya period.

After crossing the border, the journey continues in Belize. First come the mountain forests of Pine Ridge, Caracol and the caves of the Cayo district, followed by the Caribbean Sea, San Pedro and Hol Chan Marine Reserve.
